status.en: 12 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 140% more than the week before, most of them in Niamey, Kidal and Mopti.
status.nb: 12 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 140 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Niamey, Kidal og Mopti.

summary.en: Malian armed men stormed camps in the Menaka region, killing more than forty civilians in attacks attributed to Islamic State-linked militants. In Nigeria, gunmen attacked a convoy in Borno, killing fifteen soldiers and task force members, and terrorists killed soldiers at a Borno military post. Bandits raided two communities in Niger, causing scores of deaths. Mali’s military and allied armed groups continue to commit abuses against civilians. The conflict caused 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Malianske væpnede menn stormet leirer i Menaka-regionen, og drepte mer enn førti sivile i angrep som tilskrives IS-tilknyttede militante. I Nigeria angrep væpnede menn en konvoi i Borno, og drepte femten soldater og medlemmer av oppgavegruppen, og terrorister drepte soldater ved en militærpost i Borno. Banditter plyndret to lokalsamfunn i Niger, og forårsaket mange dødsfall. Mali-s militær og allierte væpnede grupper fortsetter å begå overgrep mot sivile. Konflikten forårsaket 4 159 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.extract: The War in the Sahel, also known synonymously as the Sahel War is a multi-sided armed conflict that has been ongoing since 2012. In particular, the intensive conflict mainly takes place in the three countries of Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso.
